input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression redundantly combines two time expressions; use the shorter time phrase. [teacher rule: gudai_de_shihou_why]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人：人们，This refers to a concrete group of people in general, so the plural collective noun is needed. [teacher rule: ren_renmen]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，Here the mother “sees” the influence, so use the resultative verb meaning “see/notice,” not the verb meaning “look at.” [vocab list]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜：有一个叫孟子的小男孩；他小时候从早到晚一直祭拜，At first mention, introduce the character with both a name and a full noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 他的同学们：孟子的同学们，The pronoun could refer either to the mother in the same sentence or to Mengzi; repeat the name to make the possessor clear. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 老是对他开玩笑了：老是对他开玩笑，A habitual action with 老是 takes the zero particle, not completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。：因为他每天只祭拜，所以他没有朋友。This is a cause-and-effect relationship, so use the paired connector for cause and result; 虽然 requires a contrasting second clause. [rule: coherence_connectives]

items.reason: 古代 already denotes a time period, so 古代的时候 is redundant under the teacher's rule.
人 is too generic here; 人们 is required for the people in that historical setting.
看到 correctly fixes 看了, but the corrected text still lacks 有 in 同学们对孟子有不好的影响.
This is Mengzi's first appearance, and the teacher requires a brief full-noun introduction rather than only the name.
他的 clearly refers to the recently mentioned 孟子, so there is no real ambiguity here.
老是 describes a habitual action, so it should not take completed-action 了.
虽然 has no contrasting result clause here, while 因为……所以 correctly expresses the cause and result.
